scope: development-only truth-free Android carrier-phase trajectory constraint
purpose: Evaluate a physically derived time-differenced carrier-phase displacement constraint without using any public/private Kaggle score for selection or tuning.

fixed_roles.metadata_selection_rule: Choose complete route/phone pairs with a unique brdc.nav from the central directory, excluding all profile and historical route/phone IDs. Fresh validation and holdout use distinct routes and phones and are selected before member payload access.

technical_basis.observations: Android AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters is already a range-scale quantity; satellite ECEF and per-epoch receiver WLS are present in the raw CSV.
technical_basis.signal_policy: At most one highest-CN0 observation per constellation/Svid per epoch; only the two audited signal contracts are eligible.

adr_state_policy.eligible: state has valid bit and neither reset nor cycle-slip bit

technical_basis.continuity_policy: Use a pair only when 0 < current utcTimeMillis - previous utcTimeMillis <= 1500 ms and HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount is unchanged.
technical_basis.observation_equation: delta_ADR - line_of_sight_previous dot delta_satellite = -line_of_sight_previous dot delta_receiver + receiver_clock_range_change
technical_basis.support_screen: Before implementation, read-only probes found finite ADR and dense continuous GPS/E1 pairs with at least four usable satellites on the fixed development routes; route-specific counts are recorded after generation.

frozen_candidate.base_position_lane: existing native Galileo-E1/Hatch30 POS at exact device epoch keys
frozen_candidate.displacement_solver: unweighted least squares over [ -line_of_sight_x, -line_of_sight_y, -line_of_sight_z, 1 ] with at least four eligible satellite pairs

robust_screen.gate_rule: median absolute residual about the per-epoch median; reject residuals greater than max(0.50 m, 6.0 * 1.4826 * MAD), then solve again

frozen_candidate.fallback: If continuity, state, geometry, inlier, RMS, or displacement gates fail, emit the exact finite base position for that epoch and reset the TDCP chain; never extrapolate or use truth.
frozen_candidate.segment_reset: Reset at the first epoch, any base-position gap, any pair gap over 1500 ms, hardware-clock transition, or invalid TDCP solution.

evaluation_freeze.baseline: existing native Galileo-E1/Hatch30 POS at exact device keys
evaluation_freeze.train_gate: Across the three fixed train routes, no aggregate or per-route regression versus baseline on availability, coverage, H P50/P95, V P95, or any diagnostic; require strict aggregate H P95 and diagnostic-mean improvement.
evaluation_freeze.fresh_validation_gate: After truth-free artifacts are sealed, require no regression versus baseline on all required metrics and strict H P95 improvement; otherwise do not open the unused holdout.
evaluation_freeze.unused_holdout_gate: If fresh validation passes, open the unused holdout once after artifact sealing; require no regression on all required metrics and strict H P95 improvement. No post-holdout tuning or rerun.
evaluation_freeze.promotion_scope: development-only recommended trajectory lane; production RTK/SPP defaults remain unchanged
evaluation_freeze.official_metric: not asserted; local four public-spec-compatible diagnostics are reported without using the external score
evaluation_freeze.truth_order: truth-free generation and hashes precede each permitted truth read
